title: MAWILE: Multi-Axis Workbench for Inspecting LLM Evaluators
abstract: arXiv:2609.22599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges provide a flexible and scalable method for evaluating model and agent outputs, but their verdicts can be sensitive to incidental changes in the evaluated response, judge instructions, and scoring rubric. Existing systems examine important subsets of these failure modes, but auditing a configured judge requires testing both the judge instrument and the items it evaluates. We introduce MAWILE, a developer-facing workbench for auditing judge sensitivity across four surfaces: the judge prompt, judge rubric, target-system input, and target-system output. Given a user-supplied judge and representative evaluation items, MAWILE constructs and validates controlled perturbations, re-executes the judge, and localizes the resulting sensitivity. translated_title: MAWILE：用于检查LLM评估器的多轴工作台
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）裁判为评估模型和智能体输出提供了一种灵活且可扩展的方法，但其判定结果可能对被评估响应、裁判指令和评分标准中的偶然变化十分敏感。现有系统仅考察了这些失败模式中的重要子集，而审计一个配置好的裁判需要同时测试裁判工具本身及其所评估的对象。我们提出了MAWILE，这是一个面向开发者的工作台，用于审计裁判在四个维度上的敏感性：裁判提示词、裁判评分标准、目标系统输入和目标系统输出。给定用户提供的裁判和代表性评估项目，MAWILE会构建并验证受控扰动，重新执行裁判，并定位由此产生的敏感性。每个扰动都会声明判定结果应保持不变，还是应朝指定方向变化，从而使同一系统能够同时测量对无关变化的鲁棒性……
tldr: MAWILE是一个面向开发者的多轴审计工作台，通过对裁判提示词、评分标准、目标系统输入和输出四个维度施加受控扰动，系统性检测并定位LLM裁判的敏感性。
en_tdlr: MAWILE is a developer-facing multi-axis workbench that systematically detects and localizes LLM judge sensitivity by applying controlled perturbations across four surfaces: judge prompt, judge rubric, target-system input, and target-system output.
